source.name: Iron Fist
source.originalDescription: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP. Fighter Mode: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced. The user lunges towards the target Pokémon, dealing increased damage and increasing the user's attack speed by 30% for 8 seconds. This effect can stack up to 2 times and the duration refreshes when gaining another stack.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Iron Fist は スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。

source.name: Zip Zap Full-Charge Spark
source.originalDescription: Charge toward the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage to the target and nearby opposing Pokémon. After using this move, the user enters Fighter Mode for 8s and resets the cooldown of all other moves. The Unite Move gauge will only charge when the user's basic attacks and moves hit opposing Pokémon. Basic Attacks against Pokémon from the opposing team increase Unite Move gauge by 4% and moves increase the gauge by 8%. Basic Attacks against wild Pokémon increase Unite Move gauge by 1% and moves increase the gauge by 2%. Fighter Mode: Basic attacks and move effects change, and the Unite Move gauge does not charge. Gain 30% omni-vamp while Fighter Mode is active. Buffs: 50% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Zip Zap Full-Charge Spark は シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、野生ポケモン限定の処理を持つ、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
